2105-5144-7175-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-7175-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-7175-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

222-527-6495-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-6633.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3678-5627-7857.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
3678-5627-7857.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

801-5147-5220-7855.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3734-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3734-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Phyrexian Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3734-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2781-6626-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3099-6006-6968.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4331-4993-5116-7729.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4535-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

2511-3605-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2011-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2011-3259-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Najeela as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
2011-3259-6965.notes: Najeela can make additional Warriors if you attack with multiple each iteration. Najeela doesn't have to attack after the first iteration, as the Warrior token will trigger it.

2511-2533-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2511-2533-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Carnage.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

7124-7126.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
An opponent cannot block and kill Ballista Charger.
7124-7126.notablePrerequisites:
Ballista Charger has vigilance.
Ballista Charger is a creature.
7124-7126.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Ballista Charger as attackers.
Ballista Charger triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-4188-5517.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
1978-4188-5517.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat

338-2645-4929-6824.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Spider-Man and Cryptic Trilobite trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
338-2645-4929-6824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

643-1399-1606-3664.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2608-5168-5542--108.easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
2608-5168-5542--108.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
2608-5168-5542--108.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.

1236-2018-2099.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1268-4659-4871-4917.easyPrerequisites: Crab Umbra attached to Jan Jansen.
1268-4659-4871-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
1268-4659-4871-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

2060-2092-4029-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-4029-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

144-628-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

3546-3783-4300-5361-6200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures of the type chosen with Three Tree City.
3546-3783-4300-5361-6200.description:
Activate Three Tree City's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Three Tree City from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate High Market's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion.
When the Illusion dies, Auton Soldier and Minn's second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning High Market from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier and Minn triggers, putting Three Tree City and High Market from your hand onto the battlefield, choosing any creature type for Three Tree City that you control at least four creatures of.
Repeat.

1636-1876-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1876-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-1876-5996.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2713-2757-5685.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
2713-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {1}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1142-2012-2034-2620.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Safehold Elite if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Strangleroot Geist otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Safehold Elite, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2-198-1651-5051.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
2-198-1651-5051.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Traxos and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1369-2229-4067.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {1}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of Surge Engine until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Surge Engine's third ability by paying {6}, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1675-2573-3357-4235.notablePrerequisites:
You must have a land drop available.
Four nonbasic lands under opponents' control.
1675-2573-3357-4235.description:
Activate Field, targeting a land and triggering Rings of Brighthearth.
Pay to copy the Field effect, targeting a different land.
Resolve both triggers and the resulting Ob Nixilis triggers, forcing all opponent to lose 20 life.
Use Crucible of Worlds to play Field.
Repeat steps 1-3.

618-725-1741.notablePrerequisites: Aura of Dominion attached to Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker.
618-725-1741.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker's ability to create a token copy of Cloud of Faeries.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters untap 2 lands to produce {2}.
Use this mana to untap Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker with Aura of Dominion tapping Cloud of Faeries.
Repeat.
